description:
Create URLgenius app deep links directly from ChatGPT.
Turn a webpage, product page, social profile, or app-store page into a trackable URLgenius link designed to open the right app when available and provide a reliable fallback when it isn't. Shortened URLs such as amzn.to and bit.ly work too.
URLgenius detects the destination platform and builds the app routing automatically for Amazon, Walmart, TikTok, Instagram, and thousands of other apps and platforms.
Find your existing links by path, destination, tag, or last update, and change a link's destination or tags without opening the URLgenius console.
Create one link or many in a single conversation, without preparing and uploading a spreadsheet for bulk creation.
Built for brands, agencies, creators, marketplace sellers, and marketers who need reliable app-opening experiences and faster ways to create campaign links.

defaultPrompt: Create a URLgenius deep link for [URL]
List my URLgenius links that point to amazon.com
Find my URLgenius links tagged [campaign name]
